statement: Adaptive probing produces selective rather than universal improvements, and its value depends on probe purpose and interview stage while imposing additional burden.
scope: Short online survey and HCI interview tasks using LLM-generated follow-ups.

evidence.rationale: Randomized probing increased specificity and explanation but not every qualitative or textual quality measure.
Different probe types and research stages generated materially different response-quality profiles.
Open-ended probing increased time, modestly worsened experience, and produced early attrition.

confidence_rationale: Two experiments converge that probing effects are multidimensional and conditional; samples and tasks remain bounded.
